entities.summary: Mark Harvey Crow is an American former professional basketball player who spent one season in the National Basketball Association (NBA) with the New Jersey Nets during the 1977–78 season. He was drafted by the Nets from Duke University back when the Nets represented the New York area in the sixth round during the 1977 NBA draft.
